label: Evapotranspiration, monthly (MODIS)
source: MODIS MOD16A2GF v061 (Terra, 8-day, gap-filled) via NASA AppEEARS
aggregation: 8-day ET totals prorated to calendar months by day overlap (last composite of each year is 5/6 days), per ~1 km cell; then mean of valid cells in county
notes: Actual ET (Penman-Monteith MOD16). Open water, urban and barren pixels are fill and excluded (e.g. the permanent Sudd open water), so wetland counties are under-represented. Cells need >=75% of month's days valid. Annual sums vs MOD16A3GF modis_et_mm: r=1.0, ratio 0.9999. AppEEARS area request clipped to the South Sudan outline, geographic projection.
